items.t: 基于AI的肿瘤委员会案例总结及建议面临的挑战
items.te: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
items.s: 肿瘤委员会在医院机构定期召开会议，召集癌症专家（例如肿瘤内科和病理学）来讨论患者护理。在这项工作中，我们正式将肿瘤委员会案例总结、选项生成和会议结果预测定义为人工智能任务。我们研究来自四个医疗机构的数据集，并使用专家人类评估来评估来自 DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 和 Qwen 系列的最先进的大型语言模型 (LLM)。医学肿瘤学家跨任务创建了约 9600 个参考文本和 16000 个人类判断。各机构的临床医生对大语言模型生成的病例摘要的评分为 3.57-4.59（满分 5.0），但推荐的生成仍然更具挑战性，平均得分为 2.0-3.6。
items.se: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6.

items.t: 利益相关者对肿瘤学人工智能的接受、信任和实施：混合方法系统评价
items.te: Stakeholder Acceptance, Trust, and Implementation of AI in Oncology: Mixed Methods Systematic Review
items.s: 结论：在肿瘤学中，人工智能的证据概况似乎与预期的使用和实施有所不同。最常在部署前根据经验评估验收情况；后期研究更多地考察工作流程，而较少考察透明度和治理。挑战在于有利的态度和早期部署是否转化为校准、管理和持续的日常使用。特定于阶段的解释模型确定了暴露和实施环境中的评估优先级，但不是经过验证的因果模型或预测模型。后期评估应保留对接受度、信任校准、治理、耐久性和工作流程结果的衡量。试用注册：OSF 注册中心 osf.io/nmep8；  结果：我们纳入了 309 项主要实证研究； 187 篇 (60.5%) 于 2025 年或 2026 年发表。
items.se: Conclusions: In oncology, the AI evidence profile appears to differ from anticipated use to implementation. Acceptance was empirically assessed most often before deployment; later-stage studies more often examined workflow and less often examined transparency and governance. The challenge is whether favorable attitudes and early deployment translate into calibrated, governed, and sustained routine use. An interpretive stage-specific model identifies assessment priorities across exposure and implementation contexts, but is not a validated causal or predictive model. Later-stage evaluations should retain measurement of Acceptance, trust calibration, governance, durability, and workflow outcomes. Trial Registration: OSF Registries osf.io/nmep8; https://osf.io/nmep8 Results: We included 309 primary empirical studies; 187 (60.5%) were published in 2025 or 2026.

items.te: Sexually transmitted infections, behavioural risks, and uptake of sexual health services in Britain from 2010 to 2024: findings from the repeated cross-sectional National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal).
items.se: Background Sexually transmitted infection (STI) diagnoses have increased in Britain since 2010, alongside major changes to sexual health policy, services, and disruptions owing to the COVID-19 pandemic. Meanwhile, sexual activity has decreased at population level, and more people report same-sex behaviours. To understand implications for HIV and STI control, we examined the general population prevalence of three STIs, sexual behaviours associated with STIs, and uptake of sexual health services, including HIV and chlamydia testing. Methods We conducted the fourth National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal-4) between Sept 20, 2022, and April 5, 2024. In this analysis, we used cross-sectional data from 5949 sexually experienced (who reported ever having sex) participants aged 16-59 years in Britain from the probability sample surveys.

items.t: 小肺结节随访的较少与较多强化策略：一项整群随机实用临床试验。
items.te: Less Versus More Intensive Strategies for Follow-up of Small Pulmonary Nodules : A Cluster Randomized Pragmatic Clinical Trial.
items.s: 目前肺结节随访的强度较低的指南尚未与强度较高的策略进行比较。确定小肺部结节的低强度随访是否不劣于高强度随访。非盲、整群随机、务实的比较有效性试验。 （ClinicalTrials.gov：NCT02623712）。 24 个美国医院和医疗保健系统集群。 34 686 名患者偶然发现或通过筛查发现了尺寸为 15 毫米或更小的新肺结节。后续方案以 Fleischner 协会和肺部 CT 筛查报告和数据系统 (Lung-RADS) 当前和之前的建议为蓝本。每个簇被随机分配到强度较低或较高的后续方案。主要结果是诊断时尺寸超过 20 毫米的肺癌比例。
items.se: The current less intensive guidelines for pulmonary nodule follow-up have not been compared with more intensive strategies. To determine whether less intensive follow-up of small pulmonary nodules is noninferior to more intensive follow-up. Unblinded, cluster randomized, pragmatic comparative effectiveness trial. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02623712). 24 clusters of U.S. hospitals and health care systems. 34 686 patients with a new pulmonary nodule measuring 15 mm or less, detected incidentally or by screening. Follow-up protocols were modeled on current and prior recommendations from the Fleischner Society and the Lung CT Screening Reporting and Data System (Lung-RADS). Each cluster was randomly assigned to the less or more intensive follow-up protocol. The primary outcome was the proportion of lung cancers measuring more than 20 mm at diagnosis.

items.t: 胰腺囊性病变患者胰腺癌风险预测的人工智能模型
items.te: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
items.s: 癌症风险评估是 PCL 管理的关键步骤，但现有方法的复杂性和有限的准确性导致患者护理效果不佳。我们开发并验证了一种人工智能 (AI) 模型，该模型使用放射学报告和临床数据来预测 PCL 患者未来患胰腺癌的风险。在评估的模型中，XGBoost 取得了最高的性能，预测成像后 1 年、3 年和 5 年胰腺癌发病率的 AUC 分别为 0.960、0.945 和 0.944。
items.se: Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively.

items.te: Intramuscular Olanzapine or Droperidol for Acute Behavioral Disturbance in Children and Adolescents: The PEAChY-M Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 重要性 急性行为障碍是一种高风险的急诊科表现。关于儿童和青少年肌肉注射镇静药物相对有效性的证据有限，当因躁动而面临严重伤害的迫在眉睫时，可能需要使用肌肉注射镇静药物。目的 确定奥氮平是否比肌肉注射氟哌利多更有效地实现行为控制。设计、设置和参与者 这项研究者发起的、开放标签、多中心、优越性、随机临床试验招募了 9 至 17 岁的儿童和青少年，这些儿童和青少年在 2021 年 11 月 8 日至 2026 年 2 月 16 日期间因临床认为需要肌肉注射药物的急性行为障碍到澳大利亚 10 个急诊科就诊。最后一次参与者随访发生在 2026 年 3 月 17 日。数据分析时间为 4 月 15 日至 27 日， 2026 年。
items.se: Importance Acute behavioral disturbance is a high-risk emergency department presentation. There is limited evidence for the comparative effectiveness of intramuscular sedative medications in children and adolescents, which may be required when there is imminent risk of serious harm due to agitation. Objective To determine whether olanzapine is more effective than droperidol intramuscularly in achieving behavioral containment. Design, setting, and participants This investigator-initiated, open-label, multicenter, superiority, randomized clinical trial recruited children and adolescents aged 9 to 17 years presenting to 10 Australian emergency departments with acute behavioral disturbance clinically deemed to require intramuscular medication from November 8, 2021, to February 16, 2026. The last participant follow-up occurred on March 17, 2026. Data were analyzed from April 15 to 27, 2026.

items.t: BCMA CAR-T 细胞治疗相关小肠结肠炎中粘膜 CAR<sup>+</sup> T 细胞的扩增和细胞毒性
items.te: Expansion and cytotoxicity of mucosal CAR<sup>+</sup> T cells in enterocolitis associated with BCMA CAR-T cell therapy
items.s: Ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) 是一种 B 细胞成熟抗原靶向嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞产品，被批准用于复发/难治性多发性骨髓瘤治疗。此前报道的 cilta-cel 后免疫效应细胞小肠结肠炎 (IEC-EC) 病例被描述为与克隆 CAR T 细胞群相关的严重腹泻。在此，我们报告了 MD 安德森癌症中心 158 名接受 cilta-cel 治疗的患者中出现 9 例 cilta-cel 相关的 IEC-EC 病例，并伴有 CAR T 细胞阳性 (CAR+) 浸润（6 个月里程碑时的发病率为 5.1%，全球发病率为 5.7%）。 Cilta-cel 浸润是 IEC-EC 的主要原因，通过载体整合分析、流式细胞术和 T 细胞受体测序测量，所有病例均显示单克隆或寡克隆 T 细胞群。
items.se: Ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) is a B cell maturation-antigen-targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell product approved for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma treatment. Previously reported cases of post-cilta-cel immune effector cell enterocolitis (IEC-EC) have been described as a severe diarrhea associated with clonal CAR T cell populations. Here we report nine cases of cilta-cel-associated IEC-EC with CAR T cell-positive (CAR+) infiltration in 158 cilta-cel-treated patients at MD Anderson Cancer Center (incidence of 5.1% at a 6-month landmark and 5.7% globally). Cilta-cel infiltration was the primary cause of IEC-EC, and all cases demonstrated monoclonal or oligoclonal T cell populations as measured by vector integration analysis, flow cytometry and T cell receptor sequencing.

items.te: Seasonal mass vaccination with R21/Matrix-M against malaria in The Gambia and Burkina Faso: an open-label, cluster-randomised, controlled trial.
items.s: 背景 WHO 推荐用于幼儿的 R21/Matrix-M (R21) 疟疾候选疫苗可以扩展到整个人群。在疟疾传播高峰之前进行季节性大规模疫苗接种（SMV）可能是加速消除疟疾进展的一个有前途的工具。我们的目的是评估 SMV 与 R21 在西非两个疟疾流行地区的安全性和有效性。方法 这项开放标签、整群随机、对照试验在冈比亚（一个具有低度至中度季节性传播的环境）和布基纳法索（一个具有强烈季节性传播的环境）进行。通过计算机限制随机化，54 个中等规模的村庄（冈比亚 30 个，布基纳法索 24 个）被随机分配（1:1），接受带有 R21 的 SMV（干预组）或不接受 SMV（对照组）。
items.se: Background The R21/Matrix-M (R21) malaria vaccine candidate, recommended by WHO for use in young children, could be extended to the whole population. Seasonal mass vaccination (SMV) before peak malaria transmission could be a promising tool to accelerate progress towards malaria elimination. We aimed to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of SMV with R21 in two malaria-endemic settings in west Africa. Methods This open-label, cluster-randomised, controlled trial was conducted in The Gambia, a setting with low-to-moderate seasonal transmission, and Burkina Faso, a setting with intense seasonal transmission. 54 medium-sized villages (30 in The Gambia and 24 in Burkina Faso) were randomly assigned (1:1) by use of computer-restricted randomisation to receive either SMV with R21 (intervention group) or no SMV (control group).

items.s: 重要性 医学成像的电离辐射可能会增加脑肿瘤的风险。目的 量化儿童和青少年与医学成像辐射暴露相关的脑肿瘤风险。设计、背景和参与者 对 1996 年至 2016 年出生的儿童进行回顾性队列研究，这些儿童从出生起就在美国 6 个医疗保健系统或加拿大安大略省入组，并且在 2 岁时仍存活且未患癌症，随访至 2017 年 12 月 31 日（美国站点）和 2024 年 12 月 31 日（安大略省）。暴露 医学成像对大脑造成的累积辐射剂量滞后 2 年。主要结果和措施 发生脑或其他中枢神经系统肿瘤。使用分类剂量的 Cox 比例风险模型估计危险比 (HR)，使用连续剂量的线性剂量反应模型估计过量相对风险 (ERR)。
items.se: Importance Ionizing radiation from medical imaging may increase brain tumor risk. Objective To quantify brain tumor risk associated with radiation exposure from medical imaging in children and adolescents. Design, setting, and participants Retrospective cohort study of children born from 1996 through 2016 who were enrolled from birth in 6 US health care systems or Ontario, Canada, and were alive and cancer-free at age 2 years, with follow-up through December 31, 2017 (US sites), and December 31, 2024 (Ontario). Exposures Cumulative radiation dose to the brain from medical imaging, lagged by 2 years. Main outcomes and measures Incident brain or other central nervous system tumors. Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models for categorical dose, and excess relative risks (ERRs) were estimated using linear dose-response models for continuous dose.

items.t: 西方国家认知能力和痴呆症发病率的代代相传
items.te: Generational gains in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates in Western countries
items.s: 近几十年来，欧洲和美国在任何特定年龄患痴呆症的风险都在稳步下降。一个尚未解决的关键问题是，最近几代人是否在老年时认知能力更好，认知能力下降是否较慢，或者两者兼而有之，因为这对预防性干预何时可能产生最大影响具有影响。通过对五项长达 30 年的纵向研究中约 219,000 名个体的约 783,000 次情景记忆评估进行分析，我们发现晚生的几代人受益于双重红利，进入老年时记忆水平更高，此后衰退速度更慢。综合优势足够大，可以合理地解释据报道痴呆症发病率每十年下降 13%。进步集中在下降最快的国家；
items.se: The risk of developing dementia at any given age has fallen steadily in Europe and the United States over recent decades. A key unresolved question is whether recent generations reach older age with better cognitive capacity, experience slower cognitive decline, or both, as this has implications for when preventive interventions are likely to have the greatest impact. Analyzing ~783,000 episodic-memory assessments from ~219,000 individuals in five longitudinal studies followed for up to 30 years, we find that later-born generations benefit from a double dividend, with higher memory levels entering old age and slower decline thereafter. The combined advantage is large enough to plausibly account for the reported 13% per-decade decline in dementia incidence. Improvements are concentrated among the fastest decliners;

items.se: Medicare Shared Savings Program Accountable Care Organizations Performance Year 2025 Financial and Quality Results Medicare Shared Savings Program (Shared Savings Program) Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) are critical in helping Make America Healthy Again — by supporting high-quality, coordinated care that addresses prevention, chronic illness and the root causes of disease. items.t: 索马鲁肽用于治疗 6 至 <12 岁儿童肥胖症。
items.te: Semaglutide for the Treatment of Obesity in Children 6 to <12 Years of Age.
items.s: 背景 儿童肥胖是一种慢性神经代谢疾病，有效且持久的药物治疗选择有限。第 68 周时，索马鲁肽组的 BMI 平均百分比变化为 -13.5%，安慰剂组为 2.7%（估计组间差异，-16.2 个百分点；95% 置信区间 [CI]，-19.4 至 -12.9；P < 0.001）。
items.se: Background Childhood obesity is a chronic, neurometabolic disease with limited options for medical treatments that are efficacious and durable. At week 68, the mean percent change in BMI was -13.5% with semaglutide and 2.7% with placebo (estimated between-group difference, -16.2 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -19.4 to -12.9; P < 0.001).

items.t: 每周一次利布帕肽治疗中国超重或肥胖成人的减肥效果：GEMINI-1 随机临床试验。
items.te: Once-Weekly Ribupatide for Weight Loss in Adults in China With Overweight or Obesity: The GEMINI-1 Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 重要性 肥胖是中国的一个主要健康问题；需要更多的药物治疗选择来进行长期体重管理。目的 评价每周一次皮下注射利布帕肽（一种葡萄糖依赖性促胰岛素多肽/胰高血糖素样肽 1 受体激动剂）对中国超重或肥胖非糖尿病成人减肥的有效性和安全性。设计、设置和参与者 这项多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照 3 期临床试验在中国 55 个地点进行。从 2024 年 5 月到 6 月，体重指数为 28 或更高或 24 或更高且至少有 1 种体重相关合并症的非糖尿病成人被纳入研究，最终随访日期为 2025 年 6 月 20 日。
items.se: Importance Obesity is a major health problem in China; more pharmacotherapy choices for long-term weight management are needed. Objective To evaluate the efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, for weight loss in adults in China with overweight or obesity without diabetes. Design, setting, and participants This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 clinical trial was conducted at 55 sites in China. From May to June 2024, adults without diabetes who had a body mass index of 28 or greater or 24 or greater with at least 1 weight-related comorbidity were enrolled, with final follow-up on June 20, 2025.

items.t: 替泽帕肽治疗肥胖青少年：SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS 随机临床试验。
items.te: Tirzepatide in Adolescents With Obesity: The SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 替泽帕肽是一种每周一次的葡萄糖依赖性促胰岛素多肽和胰高血糖素样肽 1 受体激动剂，已被批准用于成人肥胖症的肥胖管理，但有关其影响的重要信息在青少年中仍然有限。总体而言，79.6% 的替泽帕肽治疗参与者的 BMI 降低了至少 5%，而安慰剂组的参与者为 28.5%（风险差异，51.2 [95% CI, 36.3-66.1] 个百分点；P < .001）。
items.se: Importance Information on the effects of tirzepatide, a once-weekly glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist approved for obesity management in adults with obesity, remains limited in adolescents. Overall, 79.6% of tirzepatide-treated participants achieved BMI reduction of at least 5% compared with 28.5% of participants in the placebo group (risk difference, 51.2 [95% CI, 36.3-66.1] percentage points; P < .001).
